items.title: Zonal statistics
items.description: Summarize a raster (mean, sum, share of class) inside polygons such as tracts or parcels.
items.keywords: zonal statistics raster polygon summary mean exposure land cover share
items.inputs: A raster and polygons in the same projection
items.pitfalls: Edge pixels and polygons smaller than a pixel give unstable values.

items.title: Population-weighted exposure
items.description: Weight an environmental surface by where people live, not by area.
items.keywords: population weighted exposure environmental health air pollution heat
items.inputs: An exposure raster and gridded or block population
items.pitfalls: Residential location is not where people spend the day.

items.title: Areal interpolation and boundary crosswalks
items.description: Move counts between mismatched units, such as 2010 to 2020 tracts or tracts to towns.
items.keywords: crosswalk areal interpolation boundary change tract vintage harmonize
items.inputs: Source counts, target units, a crosswalk or weights
items.pitfalls: Area weighting assumes people spread evenly; use population weights.

items.title: Spatial join, buffers and overlay
items.description: Attach attributes by location, count points in areas, or measure what lies within a distance.
items.keywords: spatial join buffer overlay intersect distance count points
items.pitfalls: Wrong projection gives wrong distances; use a local projected CRS.

items.title: Spatial interpolation (IDW, kriging)
items.description: Estimate a surface between monitoring points.
items.keywords: interpolation kriging idw surface monitors stations
items.pitfalls: Sparse monitors give smooth surfaces that miss local hot spots.

items.title: Data fusion and downscaling
items.description: Combine monitors, model output and satellite data into a finer surface, with uncertainty.
items.keywords: data fusion downscaling calibration residual kriging machine learning air quality
items.pitfalls: Validate with spatially blocked folds; random folds overstate accuracy.

items.title: Spatially blocked cross-validation
items.description: Hold out whole regions to test whether a model works in places it has not seen.
items.keywords: validation cross validation spatial blocking autocorrelation overfitting accuracy
items.pitfalls: Random splits leak information between nearby points.

items.title: Hot spot and cluster analysis
items.description: Find clusters of high or low values (Getis-Ord Gi*, local Moran's I).
items.keywords: hot spot cluster getis ord lisa moran autocorrelation
items.pitfalls: Results depend on the neighbor definition and the unit size.

items.title: Spatial regression and GWR
items.description: Model outcomes while accounting for spatial dependence or effects that vary by place.
items.keywords: spatial regression lag error gwr geographically weighted
items.pitfalls: Check residual autocorrelation; GWR needs many units.

items.title: Difference-in-differences with places
items.description: Estimate the effect of a policy that reached some places and not others.
items.keywords: difference in differences policy effect causal event study treatment towns
items.inputs: Panel of places before and after a change
items.pitfalls: Spillovers across borders break the comparison.

items.title: Supervised land cover classification
items.description: Train a classifier (e.g., random forest) on labeled pixels from Sentinel-2 or Landsat.
items.keywords: land cover classification random forest supervised training samples satellite
items.pitfalls: Train and test samples from the same patches overstate accuracy.

items.title: Deep learning segmentation of very high resolution imagery
items.description: Map small objects such as pools, roofs, trees or damage in sub-meter imagery or drone data.
items.keywords: deep learning segmentation object detection very high resolution drone aerial small features
items.pitfalls: Models trained on one sensor or season often fail on the next.

items.title: Change detection and time series
items.description: Track change over years (NDVI differencing, LandTrendr, CCDC) or seasons.
items.keywords: change detection time series ndvi landtrendr ccdc trend deforestation canopy loss
items.pitfalls: Clouds, sensor changes and season differences look like change.

items.title: Accessibility and travel time
items.description: Measure access to services by network travel time or two-step floating catchment.
items.keywords: accessibility travel time network 2sfca service area access to care food polling places

items.title: Terrain and hydrology from elevation
items.description: Derive slope, flow accumulation, depressions and wetness index to find where water collects.
items.keywords: terrain hydrology flow accumulation depressions wetness index standing water dem lidar
items.inputs: A DEM, ideally lidar at 1 to 2 m
items.pitfalls: Coarse DEMs miss small depressions; check field conditions.

items.title: Street view image analysis
items.description: Measure greenery, sidewalks or building features from street-level photos.
items.keywords: street view imagery segmentation greenery sidewalks built environment
items.pitfalls: Coverage and capture dates are uneven; check image terms.

items.title: Mobility and visitation analysis

items.keywords: mobility foot traffic origin destination flows visits recovery smartphone
